title: Synergy Labs Blog | All About Lovable Pricing

facts.fact: The Free plan on Lovable is priced at $0 and allows 5 messages per day (30 per month), according to the page.
The Free plan allows 5 messages per day, or 30 per month, and the page describes it as suited for testing.
facts.quote: **Free Plan**: 5 messages/day (30 per month) - perfect for testing

facts.fact: The Pro plan costs $25 per month and includes 250 messages, which the page describes as ideal for solo builders.
facts.quote: **Pro Plan**: $25/month for 250 messages - ideal for solo builders

facts.fact: The Teams plan costs $30 per month for 20 seats, according to the page.
facts.quote: **Teams Plan**: $30/month for 20 seats - built for collaboration

facts.fact: The Enterprise plan uses custom pricing and includes SSO and dedicated support.
facts.quote: **Enterprise**: Custom pricing with SSO and dedicated support

facts.fact: The page states that Lovable uses message-based pricing rather than token-based pricing like competitors.
facts.quote: **Key Feature**: Message-based pricing (not token-based like competitors)

facts.fact: The page claims Lovable.dev reached £13.50 million ARR three months after launch.
facts.quote: Lovable.dev has hit £13.50 million ARR just three months after launch

facts.fact: The page claims Lovable has over 500,000 founders building apps.
facts.quote: with 500,000+ founders building apps _20 times faster_ than traditional coding

facts.fact: The page claims Lovable builds apps 20 times faster than traditional coding, which the author says is based on comparisons between traditional and AI-assisted development.
facts.quote: 500,000+ founders building apps _20 times faster_ than traditional coding

facts.fact: The page cites a 4.7-star rating for Lovable.
facts.quote: That 4.7-star rating didn't happen by accident.

facts.fact: The article was published on June 20, 2025.
The page states that the Free plan's listed key features include public projects and the Lovable badge.
